judgments.reasoning: The paper description says “Photospheric magnetic field maps for global coronal modeling.” That indicates magnetograms/maps of the photospheric magnetic field, but it does not specify whether these are line-of-sight (LOS) magnetograms or full vector field maps. HMI commonly provides LOS magnetograms for global coronal modeling (e.g., synoptic LOS/radial maps), while vector products are more specialized and typically explicitly called “vector magnetograms” or “vector field.” Given the instruction to choose UNCERTAIN when in doubt, neither model chose UNCERTAIN; however, between the two, LOS_magnetic_field is the more plausible default interpretation of “magnetic field maps” in a global coronal modeling context. VECTOR_magnetic_field is less supported by the wording. Therefore A is better than B.
